    (['Complex.I'], 'exact KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunctions.no_global_log_conjugate_aux Complex.I', False),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, proof, edge in CASES]
